title: The Perfect Fit: How to Get the Best Talent in Executive Positions. A Field Experiment in Mexico Using Vignettes
abstract: This proposed field experiment studies whether decision-makers evaluate senior-management candidates differently according to sex, marital status, and parenthood. In a Mexican talent-selection setting, decision-makers are asked to assess fictional résumés whose personal characteristics are randomly varied. The design aims to identify discriminatory patterns in executive recruitment and connect those patterns to research on discrimination and talent selection. The project’s stated objective is to generate evidence that can inform efforts to reduce bias in senior-level hiring.
